items.name: EPC contract with CIMC Raffles for fourth FLNG (FID)
items.claim: On August 12, 2026, Golar entered into an EPC contract with CIMC Raffles for a 3.5 MTPA MKII-design FLNG unit (the fourth FLNG) with an estimated fully delivered cost of approximately $2.45 billion, expected to be the earliest available newbuild FLNG capacity with delivery by end of 2029.
items.source_excerpt: On August 12, 2026, we entered into an EPC with CIMC Raffles for a 3.5 MTPA MKII-design FLNG unit (“fourth FLNG”) with an estimated fully delivered cost of approximately $2.45 billion and improved payment terms compared to the FLNG Esperanza. The fourth FLNG is expected to represent the earliest available newbuild FLNG capacity, with delivery by end of 2029.

items.name: FLNG Hilli next contract, commencing 2027
items.claim: FLNG Hilli ended its 8-year contract in Cameroon and is repositioning to Singapore for modifications ahead of its next 20-year contract commencing 2027.
items.source_excerpt: FLNG Hilli: Ended its 8-year contract in Cameroon with a 100% economic uptime since start-up, offloading 156 cargoes; currently repositioning to Singapore for modifications ahead of next 20-year contract commencing 2027.

notes: The fourth-FLNG EPC contract is from the stored Q2 2026 6-K (data/edgar/docs/GLNG.json), filed 2026-08-19, subsequent-events note.
